reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many downstream services including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these downstream services have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow internally but requests queue before frontend processes them.
Frontend CPU usage is at 76% of its very low 10m CPU limit, confirming CPU throttling and resource exhaustion at frontend.
Adservice shows some errors but only from one caller (frontend), so errors are a symptom, not root cause.
Frontend pod was recreated 331s ago due to a CPU limit change from 200m to 10m, which likely caused the resource exhaustion.
Therefore, frontend is the root cause due to resource exhaustion caused by CPU limit reduction.
The fault propagates downstream to all services called by frontend, causing increased latency and some errors on adservice.
